title: Death at the Meridian Observatory
tagline: A director falls from the great telescope on the night of the donor gala. Nobody saw a thing. Everybody is lying about something.
setting: The Meridian Observatory, a privately funded mountain observatory, on the night of its annual donor gala.
briefing: At 23:40 on Saturday night, security guard Nell Okafor found the observatory's director, Dr. Elias Voss (58), dead on the floor of the main dome beneath the telescope gantry. The donor gala had been running in the hall next door since 19:00. Voss was last seen leaving the hall at about 22:25. First responders assumed a fall on the gantry stairs. Three people had reason to quarrel with him that night: his deputy director Dr. Mara Quill, his doctoral student Theo Lark, and board chairman and principal donor Gideon Ashby. The dome corridor camera was not recording. Whether this is an accident or a homicide — and who, if anyone, should answer for it — is for the investigation to establish.

vocab.timeline: Dr. Elias Voss left the hall alive and was found dead a little over an hour later.
vocab.window: between half past ten and midnight
vocab.windowStart: from the moment Elias Voss left the hall until the alarm was raised
forensicBrief: Before anyone says "fall", let me read the floor. A stumble and a shove write completely different geometry — where he landed, how far out, what he was holding. Get me the scene untouched, his clothes, his hands, and anything electronic. The body will tell us which story is true.

I'll say this once: "he fell" is a conclusion, not an observation. I need the body position documented, the post-mortem ordered, and every exhibit sealed with continuity. Send me what you find and I'll tell you what it shows — and what it doesn't.
prosecutionOpening: Dr. Elias Voss did not simply fall. Someone stood on that gantry with him, close enough to touch, and when it was over walked back to the party.
Dr. Elias Voss did not simply fall. The evidence will show that another person was on that gantry with him.

sentences.murder: For murder the sentence is life imprisonment; I set the minimum term at eighteen years.
